basic_details.job_title: VNSGU Junior Clerk/Typist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

application_fee.details: The prescribed application fee is payable online. Bank charges towards the online payment service as applicable will be additionally payable by the candidate. The application fee will not be refunded once the form has been submitted.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for the Junior Clerk/Typist post is 35 Years.

qualification.details: Not specified in the notification. | Desirable Qualifications: Prior experience in university or government departments.

salary_details.pay_scale: Fix Salary of Rs. 26,000/- per month for first five years (Level 02: 19,900 – 63,200)
salary_details.junior clerk/typist: Fix Salary of Rs. 26,000/- per month for first five years. Level 02 (19,900 – 63,200).
salary_details.details: Recruitment for the post shall be as per Resolution No. Khrch/2002/57/Z1, dated 16-02-2006 and Resolution No. Khrch/2002/57/(Part-4)/Z.1, dated 18-10-2023 of Finance Department on fix pay for the first five years.

how_to_apply: Visit the online recruitment portal at https://vnsgunt.samarth.edu.in.
Ensure eligibility and complete the online application form on or before 11-11-2026 till 6:00 pm.
Upload all necessary documents along with the online application.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 200/- online (applicable for ST category) along with applicable bank charges.
Submit the application form and keep a printout for future reference.

Applicants already in service must apply through their proper channel or send an advance copy with required fee mentioning "ADVANCE COPY" on the envelope before the due date, and bring a "NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE" at the time of interview.
important_instructions: Any corrigendum or addendum will be published only on the University website. The selected candidate, if not already passed, will be required to pass the CCC (Course on Computer Concepts) and Hindi/Gujarati higher-level examinations during their five-year contractual period. Direct applications from candidates already in service without proper channel will not be considered unless an advance copy is sent. No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates for attending Written Examinations or Document Verification. Incomplete applications in any respect will be rejected. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. Admit cards and call letters will be sent by e-mail only.

content_sections.text: Visit the online recruitment portal at https://vnsgunt.samarth.edu.in . Ensure eligibility and complete the online application form on or before 11-11-2026 till 6:00 pm. content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (Bachelor's degree) Certificate of basic computer application knowledge Category certificate (ST certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of Gujarat) where applicable Any other necessary certificates from the competent authority for reserved category, physically handicapped, or ex-serviceman candidates No Objection Certificate (for candidates already in service)
